title: fix(changesets): sync `fixed` package list with current workspace
body:
The release workflow's `pnpm run version` step failed because `.changeset/config.json` referenced `@objectstack/service-tenant`, which has been removed from the workspace:

> 🦋 error ValidationError: The package or glob expression "@objectstack/service-tenant" specified in the `fixed` option does not match any package in the project.

Several other packages added since the config was last touched were also missing from the `fixed` group, which would have caused them to drift out of lockstep on the next version bump.

### Changes (`.changeset/config.json`)

- Removed the stale `@objectstack/service-tenant` entry.
- Added packages present in the workspace but missing from `fixed`: `account`, `console`, `plugin-approvals`, `plugin-email`, `plugin-reports`, `plugin-sharing`, `plugin-webhooks`, `service-settings`.
- Sorted the plugin and service blocks alphabetically to make future drift easier to spot.

Audit was driven by comparing `fixed` against `jq -r .name` over every `package.json` under `packages/`, `apps/`, and `examples/`.
